mapper.select:
select
from FIN_PRODUCT_OTH_CODE a,FIN_PRODUCT b, (select ITEM_CODE,ITEM_VALUE from sys_datadict_list t where t.dict_code='FINPROD_TYPE_TG')r, (select ITEM_CODE,ITEM_VALUE from sys_datadict_list t where t.dict_code='FINPROD_OTH_CODE_TYPE')n where a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID(+) and b.finprod_type2 = r.item_code(+) and a.OTH_TYPE = n.item_code(+)
and b.finprod_type2 in (select REGEXP_SUBSTR(str, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) STR from (select #{assetsType} as str from dual) CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(str, '[^,]+'))
and b.finprod_type2 in ('F01','F10','F06')
and a.FINPROD_ID in (select REGEXP_SUBSTR(str, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) STR from (select #{finprodId} as str from dual) CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(str, '[^,]+'))
and a.OTH_TYPE in (select REGEXP_SUBSTR(str, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) STR from (select #{othCodeType} as str from dual) CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(str, '[^,]+'))
AND a.DECLARED_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{vdateStart},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND a.DECLARED_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{vdateEnd},'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT a.FINPROD_ID id, a.FINPROD_ABBR text, 'FINPROD_TYPE_TG' as col, a.finprod_type2 parentId FROM FIN_PRODUCT a WHERE 1 = 1
and a.finprod_type2 in (select REGEXP_SUBSTR(str, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) STR from (select #{assetsType} as str from dual) CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(str, '[^,]+'))
and a.finprod_type2 in ('F01','F10','F06')
AND (upper(a.FINPROD_ID) like concat(concat('%', upper(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), '%') OR upper(a.FINPROD_ABBR) like concat(concat('%', upper(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), '%'))
AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND a.TRADE_MARKET in (#{TRADE_PLACE_03}, #{TRADE_PLACE_04})
order by a.finprod_type2, a.FINPROD_ID

SELECT FINPROD_ID as finprodId, BRANCH as branch, OTH_TYPE as othCodeType, OTH_CODE as othCode, REMARK as remark FROM FIN_PRODUCT_OTH_CODE WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND OTH_TYPE = #{othCodeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT a.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, f.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, a.OTH_NAME as finprodName, a.BRANCH as branch, a.OTH_TYPE as othCodeType, a.OTH_CODE as othCode, to_char(a.DECLARED_START_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as vdateStart, to_char(a.DECLARED_END_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as vdateEnd, a.DECLARED_PRICE as assetsPrice, a.REMARK as remark FROM FIN_PRODUCT_OTH_CODE a left join FIN_PRODUCT f on f.FINPROD_ID = a.FINPROD_ID WHERE OTH_CODE = #{othCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select* from (
SELECT a.FINPROD_ID id, a.FINPROD_ABBR text, 'FINPROD_TYPE_TG' as col, a.finprod_type2 parentId FROM FIN_PRODUCT a WHERE 1 = 1
and a.finprod_type2 in (select REGEXP_SUBSTR(str, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) STR from (select #{assetsType} as str from dual) CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(str, '[^,]+'))
and a.finprod_type2 in ('')
and a.finprod_type2 in ('F01','F07','F18')
AND (upper(a.FINPROD_ID) like concat(concat('%', upper(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), '%') OR upper(a.FINPROD_ABBR) like concat(concat('%', upper(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), '%'))
AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
union all
SELECT a.FINPROD_ID id, a.FINPROD_ABBR text, 'FINPROD_TYPE_TG' as col, a.finprod_type2 parentId FROM FIN_PRODUCT a WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.PROFIT_TYPE = '02'
and a.finprod_type2 in ('F17','F27')
and a.finprod_type2 in ('')
AND (upper(a.FINPROD_ID) like concat(concat('%', upper(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), '%') OR upper(a.FINPROD_ABBR) like concat(concat('%', upper(#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})), '%'))
AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
